description: The College of Spirits is the home of bards who commune with spirits and the spirits of the dead. These bards channel spiritual power through their performance.

features.name: Guiding Whispers
features.description: You can cast Guidance at will, without using a spell slot or Bardic focus. When you cast Guidance this way, you can target a creature within 60 feet of you.

features.name: Spiritual Focus
features.description: You can use a special focus object for spellcasting. This focus represents your connection to the spirit world.

features.name: Spiritual Connection
features.description: You gain the ability to communicate with spirits. You can use your Bardic Inspiration to grant creatures temporary hit points or advantage on saving throws as part of a ritualistic performance.

features.name: Astral Projection
features.description: As an action, you can spend 5 Bardic Inspiration uses to cast the spell Astral Projection without using a spell slot or material component.
